question: During the online FIFA Football Agent Exam (2026 rules), how may a candidate consult FIFA's Study Materials?
options: A) Electronically only, on the approved devices — printed copies are not allowed
B) On paper only, as a printed and indexed copy brought to the exam desk
C) Either way, plus any website you like, as long as no other person helps
D) Not at all — the FIFA Football Agent Exam is sat entirely closed-book

question: Under the FIFA Football Agent Regulations (FFAR), what is the maximum duration of a Representation Agreement between a Football Agent and a player?
options: A) Two years; it renews automatically for one more year unless either side objects
B) Five years, matching the maximum length of a professional employment contract
C) Two years; it can be extended only by signing a new Representation Agreement
D) There is no maximum, provided the player first took independent legal advice

question: Under the FFAR, when is a Football Agent entitled to receive a service fee from a Client?
options: A) Whenever the Transaction closes in the same registration period in which the agreement was signed
B) Once the Client confirms the fee amount verbally, after the Transaction has already been concluded
C) Whenever the agent's name appears in the transfer agreement, whether or not an agreement was signed
D) Only for services set out in advance in a Representation Agreement in force when they were performed

question: A club that regularly hires a Football Agent offers to buy a 20% shareholding in that agent's Agency. Under the FFAR, is this allowed?
options: A) Yes, provided the shareholding is disclosed to FIFA on the Platform in advance
B) No — a Client may not hold an Interest in a Football Agent's affairs or Agency
C) No, unless FIFA's general secretariat approves the purchase in writing first
D) Yes, but only if every player the agent represents consents to it in writing

question: Under the FFAR, when may a Football Agent first Approach a minor (or the minor's legal guardian) about Football Agent Services?
options: A) At any age, as long as the minor's legal guardian has given prior written consent to the Approach
B) No earlier than six months before they may sign a first pro contract, with the guardian's prior written consent
C) Only once the minor turns 18, regardless of what local law says about signing professional contracts
D) No earlier than twelve months before the minor turns 16, with the written consent of the minor's club

question: A licensed Football Agent misses the Platform deadline to pay the annual licence fee. Under the FFAR, what happens to the licence?
options: A) It stays active until the FIFA Disciplinary Committee holds a hearing and imposes a fine
B) It stays valid through a 12-month grace period, after which the agent must re-sit the exam
C) It is withdrawn immediately, and the agent must wait 24 months before applying again
D) It is automatically provisionally suspended, then withdrawn if not put right within 60 days

question: In Circular no. 1873 (30 December 2023), FIFA announced a worldwide temporary suspension of certain FFAR provisions until the EU Court of Justice decided the pending cases. Which of these was on the suspended list?
options: A) The two-year maximum term for Representation Agreements with players and coaches
B) The requirement that every licence applicant passes the FIFA Football Agent Exam
C) The service fee cap on the amount a Football Agent may charge in a Transaction
D) The requirement to complete continuing professional development (CPD) every year
